beats.beat: 20 Microns Nano Minerals sells four product categories: Functional Additives (FA), Chemically Modified Minerals (CMM), Soft Minerals (SM) and Hard Minerals (HM). These are specialty chemicals used in diverse industries.
The company has a long-term arrangement with corporate promoter 20 Microns Limited to market and sell its products through their network – a key dependency and strength.
Top 10 customers account for roughly 59% of revenue, indicating customer concentration. Exports to Nigeria, Saudi Arabia and Sri Lanka.

The company lists six competitive strengths: diversified product portfolio, diversified user industries, import substitution, support of holding company, product innovation/R&D, and a strong management team.

beats.beat: Revenue from operations (in ₹ lakh): Not explicitly extracted as a line item in the digest. The P&L summary extracted provides profit/loss after tax and EPS but not top-line revenue. This is a gap.

Profit after tax (PAT) turned positive from FY2015: loss of ₹27.40 lakh in FY2013 and ₹12.17 lakh in FY2014, then profits of ₹149.58 lakh (FY2015), ₹90.18 lakh (FY2016), ₹174.82 lakh (FY2017), and ₹132.75 lakh for 6 months to Sep 2017. A clear turnaround.

Operating cash flow has been volatile: ₹124.86 lakh (6mo Sep17), -₹349.75 lakh (FY17), ₹802.59 lakh (FY16), ₹422.36 lakh (FY15), ₹127.73 lakh (FY14), ₹200.97 lakh (FY13). Negative cash flow in FY17 is a risk flagged in the DRHP.
Basic earnings per share (EPS in ₹): 1.48 (6mo Sep17), 2.43 (FY17), 1.46 (FY16), 2.47 (FY15), negative 0.20 (FY14), negative 0.45 (FY13).
Total assets as at March 31, 2017: ₹3,424.96 lakh; as at Sep 30, 2017: ₹3,018.66 lakh (not disclosed if this is total or net).
Debt level: not explicitly extracted in the digest; the balance sheet provides total assets but no liabilities breakdown. Another gap.

beats.beat: Promoters: Mr. Chandresh S. Parikh, Mr. Atil C. Parikh, Mr. Rajesh C. Parikh, and 20 Microns Limited (corporate promoter). They hold 89,48,270 equity shares, 99.76% of pre-issue paid-up capital. Promoter group (excluding promoters) holds 21,510 shares, 0.24%.

The company has entered into related party transactions in each of the last five financial years and the six months ended Sep 30, 2017, as per Accounting Standard 18. Details are referenced to page 223 of the DRHP.

Governance flags from risks: instances of non-filing or delayed filings with RoC, missing statutory licenses for one manufacturing facility (Plot 9-10, GIDC Waghodia), and not owning premises for certain facilities and offices.

beats.beat: The Indian specialty chemicals segment was estimated at ₹1,000 billion in fiscal 2017, and the broader chemicals industry (excluding pharma and fertilisers) at ₹5,800-6,200 billion.

Specialty chemicals grew at 10-12% CAGR from fiscal 2014 to 2017, and CRISIL forecasts 12-14% CAGR going forward. Sub-segments like construction chemicals and water chemicals are expected to grow at 15% CAGR.

Key demand drivers include increased consumption, urbanisation, GDP growth, and government initiatives like the Draft National Chemical Policy and 100% FDI allowance. Favorable global factors include China's stricter environmental regulations pushing buyers to India.
The industry is highly fragmented – SMEs hold 70-75% market share – with global giants present. Limited Indian players compete on product innovation.

Regulatory factors: GST implemented July 2017, REACH compliance for EU exports, and PCPIRs (Petroleum, Chemicals and Petrochemicals Investment Regions) approved in four states with total proposed investments of about ₹9 trillion.

beats.beat: 20 Microns Nano Minerals Limited processes and sells specialty chemicals – functional additives, chemically modified minerals, soft and hard minerals – used across industries. It is a small company listing on the SME platform of NSE (NSE EMERGE) to raise capital for a new plant and to create a public market for its shares.
The company relies heavily on its corporate promoter, 20 Microns Limited, for marketing and sales through its network.

intro.purpose: Orient the reader: who 20 Microns Nano Minerals is, what it does, what it is raising and where it will list.

beats.beat: The offer structure: the DRHP does not specify a split between fresh issue and offer for sale in the extracted facts. The objects include funding capital expenditure for a new manufacturing facility at Plot 336, GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat, and general corporate purposes. Listing on NSE EMERGE is also an objective.
Lead manager: Vivro Financial Services Private Limited. Registrar: Link Intime India Private Limited.
The offer does not appear to include an OFS based on the extracted facts – the digest has no mention of selling shareholders. This is a gap.

offer.heading: The IPO offer
offer.purpose: Detail the offer structure – fresh issue vs OFS (if any – not disclosed in digest), use of proceeds, lead manager, registrar.

beats.beat: No long-term customer or supplier agreements: the company operates on purchase orders only, making revenue and margins vulnerable to sudden changes.
Negative operating cash flow in FY2017 (₹-349.75 lakh) could constrain growth and debt servicing. The filing itself flags this risk.
Missing statutory licenses for the manufacturing facility at Plot 9-10, GIDC Waghodia – the company cannot assure it won't be penalised, which could disrupt operations.
Heavy reliance on corporate promoter 20 Microns Limited for marketing and sales. Any disruption in that relationship could severely impact revenue.
The company and its promoters are party to legal proceedings; adverse decisions could materially affect financial condition.
